name: nontrivial-load
completionClock: browser predicate observation + double-rAF opportunity; not physical scanout or completion of all later app work
feedbackScope: action-related retained cue plus double-rAF opportunity; no physical scanout claim
gapScope: post-marker interval may contain app work, later stalls and driver delivery; no pure-overhead attribution
frameScope: per-operation observations may extend past latency marker; session window required for continuous-stall claims

feedback.preHandlerOrdering: window capture; adapter must prove this precedes its app mutation path
feedback.scope: action-related retained cue plus double-rAF opportunity; no physical scanout claim
feedback.detectionScope: cancellable post-dispatch timer task, then frame probes; task scheduling delay included
feedback.collectionScope: outside host clock; validation and full record copies; host RPC separately measured

feedbackCollectionWindow.scope: bounded post-HC-marker observation; original latency/terminal fields unchanged; no physical first-pixel claim
